payload.text: My gear loan is paid off and I have two years of expenses banked. Offer A pays $178,000 to write permit-stage impact assessments for a pipeline developer, and the reports stay confidential. Offer B pays $121,000 on a basin-resilience team publishing open flood maps with counties and tribal governments, with two field weeks a month. Which would I probably take, and what tradeoff would weigh most?
